channel.title: Palm Coast Observer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Palm Coast Observer (observerlocalnews.com)

item.title: Pine Trail, Seabreeze upgrades move forward, Volusia School Board approves bond amendment
item.description: Due to a Pine Ridge classroom project being delayed, seven facilities projects are being fast-tracked. Also, VCS welcomed its new chief financial officer.

item.title: Daytona Beach commissioner asks for updated analyses when reviewing older development projects
item.description: The topic came up when the commission was reviewing an amendment request for a 226-acre development located on the northwest side of Interstate 95 and International Speedway Boulevard.

item.title: Flagler Schools preparing to search for auditorium director's replacement — it won't be easy
item.description: Flagler Auditorium Director Amelia Fulmer is retiring on July 31. The proposed job description for her replacement is expansive.

item.title: Tanger Outlets Daytona Beach to host appearance by NASCAR driver Casey Mears
item.description: At the end of the meet-and-greet, Tanger will contribute $10,000 to The Gracie Foundation, supporting women undergoing cancer treatment.

item.title: My View: Exceptional cost savings and extraordinary results for the Flagler County Sheriff’s Office
item.description: 'Fiscal discipline, transparency, and accountability have defined the Sheriff’s Office under my leadership,' writes Sheriff Rick Staly.

item.title: My View: Flagler County Sheriff Rick Staly is overspending
item.description: Former sheriff James Manfre writes that, over that past 10 years, the county's population has increased by 30%, but Staly's budget has increased by over 120%.

item.title: 'Half-marathons are my sweet spot': Living kidney donor Christina Moore thrives on the run
item.description: In 2021, Christina Moore donated one of her kidneys then ran the Disney Princess half-marathon the following year.

item.title: Flagler County Sheriff’s Office deputies de-escalate dangerous armed individual
item.description: The suspect, who was having a severe mental health crisis, pointed a weapon and deputies.

item.title: Bill requiring English-only driver license tests clears Florida House panel
item.description: HB 1307 would prohibit 'unauthorized aliens' from getting any licenses the state Department of Financial Services issues, such as those related to insurance.

item.title: Volusia, Flagler law enforcement agencies reimbursed by Florida for supporting ICE operations
item.description: Florida's chief financial officer presented a total of $1.7 million to six local law enforcement agencies. The FCSO received the largest sum of funds, at over $725,000.
